title: With the Crop tool, dragging across the picture draws the crop box you want
goal: With the Crop tool, the person wants to drag out the area to keep, the way a marquee is drawn, not to nudge a full-size box in from its edges. Today a press inside the crop box moves it, and only a press outside it draws a new one; since the box starts as the whole picture, there is no 'outside' on the picture, so drawing a crop box is effectively impossible. Dragging anywhere on the picture should draw a new crop box; the handles still resize it.
notes: User, 2026-11-03 (intake): 'the crop tool is rather irritating because what I really want to do is select a box, rather than resize a box. I think resizing is fine but if i drag a box, that should adjust the cropping rectangle to that.' Code: Sources/Photonz/CanvasPointerDrags.swift ~201-223: in Crop mode a press on a handle resizes (CropDrag .resize), a press inside cropRect MOVES it (.move), only a press outside DEFINES a new rect (.define(anchor:)). The box starts as the whole picture, so the inside-moves rule swallows every drag on the picture. Change the inside case to define; move becomes Space-drag. Crop math in Sources/PhotonzCore/Crop.swift.
acceptance: At Next defaults, Crop tool on a screenshot: press anywhere that is not a handle (inside the current box or outside it) and drag: a new crop box is drawn from the press to the pointer, live, and replaces the old one. A click without a drag changes nothing.
The eight handles still resize the box as today (and keep the aspect lock when one is set).

Moving a box: hold Space while drawing to reposition the box being drawn (as Photoshop's and Preview's marquee do); with the box drawn, hold Space and drag inside it to move it; the arrow keys nudge it (Shift for 10). Option draws from the centre, Shift keeps a square (or the locked aspect). Double-click inside or Return still commits, Escape cancels, as today.
The hover cursor says what a press will do: a crosshair where it draws, the resize cursors on handles, the open hand with Space held.
Snapping and the size readout work while drawing as they do while resizing.

Walks: draw a crop box inside a full-picture box; redraw over it; resize by a handle; Space-reposition while drawing; Space-drag to move; nudge; commit; Escape. Before and after reel in the audit under queue/audits/.
Update docs/design/tools.md's crop section with the new gestures.
Anything left rough is filed as a follow-up task if it clears the follow-up bar (queue/bin/follow-up-bar.md), and written into this task's log if it does not.

log.note: Reproduced first: crop-before walk with next-crop-draws-a-box off, a drag 300,200 to 900,600 inside the box that opens over the whole picture leaves cropBox 0, 0, 1440, 960 (nothing drawn).

Adversarial review before building: a first-time user presses on the picture and drags, which is a marquee everywhere else in the app, so drawing is the expected verb; Photoshop users know Space-to-move from the marquee; risk is losing move-inside, covered by Space-drag and the arrows. No mock covers Crop gestures. Gaps the app could not deliver: no keyUp on the canvas and no way for a walk to hold Space, both added; no crop size readout or snapping existed for resizing either, so the readout pill was added to both and snapping left out (resizing has none).

Chose: gated behind a new Next flag next-crop-draws-a-box (on in Next, absent in Current) because the crop press is shared code and Current must not change. Chose: Space held means every press moves the box (handles included) because the pointer is an open hand everywhere then. Chose: a 3pt click tolerance so a click keeps the box.

Review on the real app (probe): a draw that started right after a handle drag held the resize arrows as its cursor while the button was down (walk log 'cursor while down resize-up-left-down-right'); fixed, a draw press now puts the crosshair back. Looked at 2-drawing, 4-space-slides, 7-cropped captures and the contact sheet: they show the box drawn inside the full-picture box with its 600 x 400 pill, the slid box, and the cropped 1040 x 700 picture; the before frames show the box unchanged.

left rough (no task, below the follow-up bar): crop has no snapping while drawing or resizing (it never had, the acceptance item asked for parity with resizing, which this has); the pointer stays a crosshair while Space slides a box being drawn; Space with Crop in hand no longer plays a picture's motion preview. All three are in the audit's rough list for the user to react to.

Walks: crop-draws-the-box-you-drag-walk (new, Next defaults, no flags) passes: draw inside the full box, click keeps it, redraw over it, handle resize, Space slide mid-draw, Space-drag move, nudge 1 and Shift 10, Option from centre, Shift square, Escape mid-drag, Return commits. crop-cue, crop-resize-command, crop-rounds-the-card, every-handle-lights-on-hover pass. design-mode-tool-strip-walk fails at a Tool Component menu (already in the sweep's failing list) and tool-and-library-dropdowns-open-on-a-click-walk times out at a component drag on main too (folded into walks-that-fail-in-the-full-sweep-26). Scripts/test.sh green.

Crop in Next: a drag anywhere off a handle draws the crop box (inside the full-picture box too), handles resize, Space slides a box being drawn and moves one at rest, arrows nudge, Option/Shift draw from centre/square, size pill while drawing or resizing.
